name: CONTAINER-ONYX
teaser:
"How'd you even get the Kappa case?"
This mod adds a new secure container, larger then the Kappa case.
description_html:
DEPENDENCY: SARIA SHOP

MAKE SURE TO LOAD THIS MOD AFTER SARIA SHOP!

Credits and Usage

Certified ROPE™ project

Thank you DJLang for doing alot of the coding, Cannucia for the 3D Model (Mod: CNN-CONTAINERS), and TheSparta and Chomp for helping with errors! Without you guys, I wouldn’t have been able to make this mod, so thank you.

Use: This mod adds a secure container, which means if you die, the items you keep in it aren’t lost.

How do I get this? : You’re gonna need Saria at level 4 and have the kappa case + 10.9 million roubles. (You can get the kappa case easily with the Saria trader.)

DISCLAIMER: This secure case has no filter, You can put guns and shit in it

Incompatibilities, Known errors

It shouldn’t have any incompatibilities, if there are, feel free to make a comment! (Same with errors)

KNOWN PROBLEMS: None anymore.

Installation

1. Unzip the file
2. Go inside of the unzipped file
3. Drag the “user” folder into your main SPT folder.

(Yes, I know that this isn’t my mod, I just took it from one of Drakia’s mods, didn’t feel like making one for this mod specifically.)
